const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('docs/quality/summary-qa/root/2026-11-05-batch-002957/current-snapshot-revalidation-2026-11-07/iteration-02/reader-b.json')
d=json.loads(p.read_text()); guide=p.with_name('summary-snapshot.md').read_text()
expected={
'Q01':['Rule determination and ordinary ties','Tokens and Vagabond pawn','Eyrie ties'],
'Q02':['Requirements for a normal move','Repeated movement','Rivers'],
'Q03':['Battle initiation and Ambush','Before-roll effects, dice and after-roll effects','Count hits and defenseless bonus','Deal hits, removal priorities and scoring'],
'Q04':['Crafting costs and suit matching','Use limits and Vagabond reuse','Missing item supply','Duplicate persistent effect'],
'Q05':['Activation timing and VP threshold','Victory conditions','Activated card replacement or discard'],
'Q06':['Spent dominance card','Taking an available dominance card'],
'Q07':['Two-player deck and hand','Ruins and map item supply','Faction setup order'],
'Q08':['Keep placement and entry','Field Hospitals','Ambush at the Keep','Rebuilding the Keep'],
'Q09':['Daylight order and action allowance','March','Recruit','Overwork'],
'Q10':['Legal clearing and building selection','Wood cost and network','Placement and scoring']}
checks={
'Q01':['warriors and buildings','ordinary tie','Tokens and pawns','Eyrie'],
'Q02':['positive number','rule is rechecked','repeatedly','Rivers do not count'],
'Q03':['foiled Ambush','two immediate hits','ends immediately','capped','extra hits','all its warriors','one VP'],
'Q04':['once per turn','exhausting one face-up, undamaged hammer','cannot be crafted','Only an identical persistent effect'],
'Q05':['10 or more VP','start of your own Birdsong','three clearings','two diagonally opposite','cannot be removed or replaced'],
'Q06':['near the map as an available','bird card; a bird card can pay for a non-bird'],
'Q07':['remove all four dominance cards','three cards','one under each','Marquise, Eyrie, Alliance, then Vagabond'],
'Q08':['Only the Marquise','matching that clearing','before checking whether no attackers remain','cannot be placed again'],
'Q09':['up to three actions','up to two moves','once per turn','matching a sawmill'],
'Q10':['clearing you rule','leftmost building','unbroken chain of ruled clearings','score the VP']}
assert [a['id'] for a in d['answers']]==[f'Q{i:02}' for i in range(1,11)]
for a in d['answers']:
 assert [x['part'] for x in a['answer']]==expected[a['id']], (a['id'],'coverage parts')
 assert all(x['ruling'].strip() and x['evidence'] for x in a['answer'])
 for passage in a['source_passages']:
  assert passage['quotation'] and passage['quotation'] in guide, (a['id'],passage['section'])
 joined=' '.join(x['ruling'] for x in a['answer'])
 for phrase in checks[a['id']]: assert phrase.lower() in joined.lower(), (a['id'],phrase)
print('Q01–Q10 coverage and contradiction checks passed; quotations remain exact substrings.')
PY","workdir":"/home/jonny/projects/boardgame-rules","max_output_tokens":1000}); text(r.output);
